features.title: See which container or ship holds an item
features.description:
On the ASSETS screen, items inside a container or ship now show exactly which one under the station in the LOCATION column, with its name and the bay or slot, for example Paladin “Lasers Go Brr” › Cargo. Hover the location to see the full path.

The SEARCH box also finds items by container or ship name. Names appear after the next asset sync.
